title: Regional order integration: risk-assessment
summary: Three regional order services, ERP integration, identity management and two operations teams. Reconcile regional orders within 15 minutes with 99.9 percent monthly availability and no duplicated financial postings. An idempotent event gateway connects three regional services to ERP using versioned schemas and a dead-letter queue.

scenario.name: Regional order integration
scenario.scope: Three regional order services, ERP integration, identity management and two operations teams.
scenario.drivers: Reconcile regional orders within 15 minutes with 99.9 percent monthly availability and no duplicated financial postings.
scenario.design: An idempotent event gateway connects three regional services to ERP using versioned schemas and a dead-letter queue.
scenario.cost: EUR 420000 implementation and EUR 90000 annual operation; three-year avoided handling cost EUR 810000, sensitive to order volume by 30 percent.
scenario.risk: Replayed events can duplicate postings; deduplication keys and reconciled ledger totals reduce exposure but require weekly evidence review.
scenario.operations: Regional service owners retain customer support; the integration team owns gateway recovery and ERP reconciliation escalation.
